releaseNotes: Mail without a recognized academic subject is mapped to its teacher's single known subject, using this student's saved assignments and teacher updates. Message titles no longer populate the subject filter.
Unknown senders and teachers with multiple subjects remain General / Unclassified rather than being guessed. Original titles, private Reviewed flags and linked resources are preserved.
The update progress bar uses the available width. Section indicators wrap on narrow screens instead of requiring horizontal scrolling.
The subject correction applies to existing saved mail without a full LMS refresh. Credentials, schedules, history and assignment status are preserved; school access remains read-only.
